test_create_table: test creating tables via schema definition, AS SELECT, and LIKE in SQLContext
test_delete_clause: test deleting rows from a table with various WHERE constraints including null handling
test_drop_table: test dropping a table entirely from the SQL context
test_show_tables: test listing all tables registered in the SQL context in sorted order
test_truncate_table: test truncating a table to remove all rows while preserving its schema
